text:
Maya: First-run wizard keeps bouncing me to login when my config dir is a symlink to ~/dotfiles. redwoodctl prompts every new shell even after successful auth.
Ryan: ugh. which redwoodctl version and how is the symlink arranged?
Maya: macOS 13.6, redwoodctl 0.24.1 (homebrew). ~/.redwood -> ~/dotfiles/redwood (dir).
Sasha: any logs in ~/.redwood/logs?
Maya: nothing obvious. i run `redwoodctl auth whoami` after login and it returns my user, then next command suddenly 401s and asks to login again.
Ryan: can you paste `ls -l ~/.redwood` and `stat ~/.redwood`?
Maya: ```
$ ls -l ~/.redwood
lrwxr-xr-x  1 maya  staff  20 Mar  5 10:02 /Users/maya/.redwood -> /Users/maya/dotfiles/redwood
$ stat -f "%N %Sp %Su" /Users/maya/dotfiles/redwood
/Users/maya/dotfiles/redwood drwxr-xr-x maya
```
Nora: permissions look normal. the CLI writes tokens via atomic write+rename; on darwin the rename can fail if the temp file and target are on different inodes (symlink->repo). I think the write ends up not replacing the target so token never appears, hence repeated login.
Sasha: confirmed on my M1 with homebrew binary. repro steps: symlink config dir into tracked repo, run `redwoodctl auth login`. cli writes temp file under /var/folders/... then rename fails silently and leaves the temp file. subsequent calls read stale state.
Maya: any workaround? moving dotfiles repo isn't an option for me.
Ryan: short-term: set REDWOODCTL_CONFIG to resolved path: `export REDWOODCTL_CONFIG="$HOME/dotfiles/redwood"` and then run `redwoodctl auth login`. CLI will write directly to that path and avoid cross-filesystem rename.
Maya: confirmed that fixes it for me, thanks.
Nora: filing DEVEX-5123. marking priority P1 for a small patch to resolve path before atomic write or fall back to copy+chmod when rename fails. devex-bot: add labels `symlink` `auth` `darwin`.
devex-bot: Ticket DEVEX-5123 created by Nora: "redwoodctl login loop with symlinked config dir on macOS".
Sasha: i'll prepare a patch: try os.Rename, on error check if target is a symlink/resolved path and then write to resolved target or perform safe copy. will add integration test that creates a symlinked config dir in CI (darwin matrix).
Maya: please also add a short troubleshooting note to the onboarding guide explaining the REDWOODCTL_CONFIG workaround for dotfiles users.
Nora: will do. ETA for patch: next weekly patch (~4 days).
Ryan: we'll add a quick e2e on homebrew-built binary against symlinked config dir too.
Maya: happy to smoke test beta :thumbsup:
Sasha: thanks everyone, closing the loop for now.
